name: Browser Tooling Auto-Spawn
description: shark-browser-test must auto-spawn a shark-browser container or provide clear actionable error

evidence.fixDetails: findTestContainer() now only returns browser-image containers (P1) or auto-spawns shark-browser-{date} (P2). Removed fallback to general shark containers.
evidence.namespaceIsolation: Only returns containers with opencode-test-browser:1.0 image. Never falls back to tst-*, spider-*, trident-*.
evidence.compiledBehavior: Existing dist uses pre-compiled code. Source fix applied to src/tools/shark-browser-test.ts. Build blocked by firewall (L5.19 container escape prevention).

criteria.passCondition: Tool auto-spawns shark-browser-{date} or provides clear actionable error with exact docker command
criteria.failCondition: Tool throws Container exec failed with no remediation
